narrative.title: The Unlimited Charter Cycles
narrative.scenario: The broker's charter deal went unlimited: lock and release the depot fee as many times as desired, one share of cargo at a time, and even same-hour round trips are legal. Dispatch wants the maximum cumulative spread across the whole horizon. Every rise in the fee curve can now be captured piece by piece.
narrative.inputFormat: An array prices where prices[i] is the fee on hour i.
narrative.outputFormat: Return the maximum total profit with unlimited buy-sell transactions, holding at most one unit at a time.

testCases.explanation: Lock at 1, release at 5 (+4); lock at 3, release at 6 (+3) — total 7.
One long hold captures the entire climb: release at 5 after locking at 1.

hintLevels: Level 1: With unlimited trades, every upward step between consecutive hours is free money.
Level 2: Either sum all positive daily deltas, or run the hold/skip state machine across the days.
Level 3: The state-machine form generalizes to cooldowns and fees; the delta-sum only works here.
